# Forge skills

<!-- Generated by tools/build_forge_catalog.py from each skill's SKILL.md and ucs.yaml, and skills/forge/forge.yaml. Don't edit by hand. -->

The skills Forge installs, and what each one needs and produces. Start every build with `forge`: it picks the use case, and that skill asks for its required inputs before it builds anything.

| Name | Description | Input | Outputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`forge`](skills/forge/SKILL.md)<br>Entry point | Entry point for Forge, which builds complete, evaluated Databricks solutions from the documents in a Unity Catalog volume (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images): document Q&A (RAG) agents and chatbots that cite their sources, AI Search (Vector Search) indexes and knowledge bases over documents, and extraction of fields, entities, and line items from documents into typed tables, including document packets and review queues. | a plain-language request for what to build, plus any build already in progress (a use case's state file in the working directory) | a handoff to the matching use-case skill, which builds the result, or a pointer to the base skill that covers the request; it builds nothing itself |
| [`forge-doc-qa-agent`](skills/forge-doc-qa-agent/SKILL.md)<br>Document Q&A agent | Builds and deploys a cited document Q&A (RAG) agent over the documents in a Unity Catalog volume, as a LangGraph agent on Databricks Apps (Agent Runtime) that runs hybrid searches with metadata filters on an AI Search index and cites [file_name, p. N], with managed sessions and MLflow evaluation. Runs `forge-unstructured-doc-extraction` first when the documents aren't indexed yet. | **Required:** none<br>**Builds on:** `forge-unstructured-doc-extraction`, which it runs first if needed<br>**Optional:** `index_state`, `name`, `chat_model`, `eval_set` | a LangGraph agent on Databricks Apps, with sessions, citations, and an MLflow evaluation<br>**State file:** `doc-qa.json` |
| [`forge-unstructured-doc-extraction`](skills/forge-unstructured-doc-extraction/SKILL.md)<br>Document search index | Parses the documents in a Unity Catalog volume (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images) and serves them from an AI Search (Vector Search) index for retrieval by an agent or app, with incremental ai_parse_document parsing (including PDFs over 500 pages and scans split into one file per page), ai_prep_search chunks with document-level metadata filters, optional chart readings by a vision model, optional refresh on file arrival, and a retrieval evaluation (document and page hit rates) in MLflow. | **Required:** `volume_path`, `vs_endpoint`, `index_name`, `continuous_updates`<br>**Optional:** `profile`, `target_schema`, `name`, `metadata_schema`, `embedding_model`, `page_images`, `chart_insights`, `chart_model`, `split_pages`, `eval_set` | an AI Search index with metadata filters, a job that keeps it current, and a retrieval evaluation in MLflow<br>**State file:** `doc-index.json` |
| [`forge-structured-doc-extraction`](skills/forge-structured-doc-extraction/SKILL.md)<br>Structured extraction | Extracts fields, entities, and line items from the documents in a Unity Catalog volume (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images) into typed Delta tables, with a citation and confidence score for every value: incremental ai_parse_document parsing, ai_classify v2.1 routing for mixed documents and multi-document packets such as loan or claim files, ai_extract v2.1 per document type, a review queue of low-confidence values, an optional review app (Lakebase and AppKit) where people approve or correct them and their decisions are written back to the tables, accuracy scoring against labeled documents in MLflow, and optional word-level bounding boxes from OCR. | **Required:** `volume_path`, `review_app`<br>**Optional:** `profile`, `target_schema`, `name`, `layout`, `document_types`, `provided_schema`, `split_pages`, `review_threshold`, `ground_truth`, `localize` | typed Delta tables per document type with citations and confidence scores, a review queue, optionally a review app whose approvals and corrections are written back to the tables, and an accuracy evaluation in MLflow<br>**State file:** `extraction.json` |
